name: Digambara Digambara
meaning: Salutations to Digambara, the sky-clad one; salutations to Shripada Vallabha.
purpose: A devotional chant associated with Dattatreya and Shripada Vallabha.
when: As a devotional chant when reflecting on simplicity.
note: The client list includes further words after this refrain that are textually uncertain; they are not given here until checked against the particular Datta tradition.
supplied:
Digambara Digambara Shree Pad Vallabha Digambara
Datta Guruve Namah Smara Parmeshwar Aha Jage Hara
